_notes: YOUR HOUSE RULES. Empty by default. Fill these in with words and phrasings you never want on a slide.
banned_words: whole words, any capitalisation. Example: ["synergy", "leverage"]. A hit stops the render.
banned_phrases: any capitalisation, matched anywhere in the text. Example: ["game changer", "in today's world"]. A hit stops the render.
signoff_line: the line you end every post caption with, if you have one. Leave empty if not.
signoff_required: true means the spec's caption must end with signoff_line. The sign-off never goes on a slide.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the checker.
